name: Tank 1
notes:
West-edge high tank on the ridge, about 135 m: first priority for the Bunyip. Size: 5–10 kL, added with the Bunyip lines.
Filled by Bunyip line 1 (the existing 210 m delivery pipe); near the pump's 82 m lift limit, so expect slow filling.
Gravity-feeds the west edge for irrigation and firefighting; a tee with a small solar booster runs on to Tank 5 in the SW corner.
